reply.say: The platform feels steady and the view is wide—nice to pause here.

action.text: Nice to meet you up here, Alex. I’m good with heights—thanks for giving me space. From this vantage, have you noticed anything odd near the bell or that stone circle? Have you tried ringing the bell, or checking the chest or crate down there? I saw the bridge and cabin on my way. In a bit we can lower the rope to haul up the lantern—no rush. Also, mind if I hang onto this snorkel for later?

- 05:10–11:42: Walked to tall metal ladder; coordinated with a young man (“Alex”) on the platform. Set lantern and rope at base. Climbed ladder to the 100-ft platform.
- 11:42–13:33: On platform: inspected table (lighter, sword, snorkel). Picked up snorkel; later picked up lighter and tested it (it produced a flame briefly). Set tin cup on platform table.

- 31:12–33:16: Began Journal Entry #2 by the bell; stood when Alex approached.
